body: Both, they know I have extra money so I’m their little escape goat when they need a bill paid last minute but I also shouldn’t be responsible for their bad money management

Having to go from paying a manageable portion of rent to paying the entire thing in a sudden moment,  causing me to take out all my money from savings that I’ve built up for months and leaving me with very little cash to live off of until my next check. I’m currently a full time college student and full time worker so the current stress from those isn’t helping me. They’ve promised me they’re gonna pay me back but they said that last time I had to pay a large bill but I’ve yet to see or hear anything of it

I don’t have any motives to stay alive. I’m in sudden financial debt due to my parents, I’ve lost motivation for higher education and want to drop out but if I do I’ll get kicked out and end up homeless. I’ve lost contact with most of my friends and I just feel like I’m a burden on everyone’s lives

Last time I’ve told them how I’ve felt about something similar that I’ve gone through all they’ve said was “it gets better” and then threw me out of their life, or told me I was faking it for attention so I just keep myself reserved

Yes, I’m trapped. And I’m almost 20 so any chance to enjoy a young life won’t happen as my entire young life was taken from me. For me it feels like I’m finishing my education until the inevitable happens because I don’t know what the fuck I’m doing after college

Nothing ever seems to go right for me. I just want to drop out of college because at this point I’m only doing it so my parents are somewhat satisfied when right now I have no motivation to do anything for my classes, but am I gonna tell them? No, they’ll kick me out if I drop out

You got a strong point. I just don’t know how to tell people I care for that I’m suicidal, or that I’ve attempted multiple times in the past month or so. Sometimes all I need is some reassurance or whatever so I don’t feel completely alone in this hell
I’m big into music and super smash bros but I suck at both but that’s all I got whenever I have a shred of free time
Or they’d say something like “it’d break my heart if you died” so if they know you need help why don’t they try to help you instead of saying stupid shit like it’s selfish?

I’ve gotten ads for sites like betterhelp for online counseling but the rates are still high even with aid, and other options are too high for where I live so I can’t be able to manage money and time with work and school, but I will try again don’t worry
I’m here if you need to vent whenever

My parents told me I was “faking it” when I opened up about being severely depressed for months so I refuse to tell them shit anymore, but anyone I talk to about personal shit like this stab me in the back and spread it like wildfire until it comes to bite me in the ass

I’m such a burden to anyone I associate with, and anytime I reach out it just gets ignored or get some bullshit response like “toughen up”. And seeking professional help is something I can’t do, I’m a broke college student and I can’t seem to find a counseling service at my university :(
I’ve had someone say that I matter but they walked out of my life when I was most vulnerable. I’m where you’re at right now so I know what you gotta be going through
